properties.name: Casablanca — Marrakech — Ouarzazate 400kV
properties.description: Backbone corridor connecting Morocco's economic capital to the Noor solar complex. This 400kV double-circuit line evacuates up to 600 MW of solar generation from Ouarzazate through Marrakech into the Casablanca load center — the grid's heaviest consumption node.

properties.name: Casablanca — Kenitra — Tangier 400kV
properties.description: Northern backbone linking Casablanca to the Tangier Med industrial zone. Carries power from Jorf Lasfar northward and supports the HVAC interconnect to Spain across the Strait of Gibraltar (1,400 MW bidirectional capacity).

properties.name: Oujda — Fès — Rabat 400kV
properties.description: Eastern corridor connecting the Algerian border interconnect at Oujda through Fès to the capital. Supports bilateral energy exchange with Algeria (COMELEC) and evacuates power from the Ain Beni Mathar ISCC plant.

properties.name: Jorf Lasfar — Casablanca 400kV
properties.description: Direct 400kV feed from Jorf Lasfar thermal complex to the Grand Casablanca load center. One of the highest-loaded transmission corridors in Morocco, carrying up to 2 GW from the country's largest power station.

properties.name: Tangier — Oujda 225kV Corridor
properties.description: Northern coastal and interior 225kV distribution linking Atlantic and Mediterranean coasts through the Rif region. Connects Tangier Med port zone with eastern border interconnect.

properties.name: Rabat — Fès — Marrakech 225kV Corridor
properties.description: Central spine connecting the capital to historic inland cities and southern corridor. Supports regional load and renewable evacuation from the Anti-Atlas region.

properties.name: Agadir — Marrakech — Tarfaya 225kV Corridor
properties.description: Southern and Atlantic corridor from industrial south to wind farm zones. Primary evacuation route for Tarfaya (300 MW) and future southern renewable capacity. Traverses Souss-Massa, Haouz, and Atlantic regions.

properties.name: Dakhla — Agadir HVDC Corridor
properties.description: Planned inland HVDC corridor to evacuate massive wind and solar resources from the Dakhla region (>2,500 kWh/m²/yr, 9+ m/s wind) to the southern grid hub at Agadir — spanning ~1,000 km. Central to Morocco's green hydrogen export strategy and the proposed Xlinks Morocco-UK Power Project (3.6 GW HVDC subsea export to UK).

properties.name: Spain-Morocco HVAC Interconnect (Reinforcement)
properties.description: Reinforcement of existing Spain-Morocco HVAC link through Strait of Gibraltar. Current 1,400 MW capacity; expansion studies underway (Eurafrica initiative) to support increased renewable exports and cross-border balancing service provision to EU.
